svg.text: Native GPU request E2E OOF quality
Direct native:e2e requests only · 2,080 train-calibration requests · five instance-grouped folds · token/cache candidates are conditional replay.
Primary native target is direct request E2E. Queue/prefill/decode rows are diagnostics and are not summed here.
Cross-hardware transfer is unvalidated; cache points use a supplied realized cache trace.
